contents: # The slides of phil/slides: see vendor/phil/slides/doc/configuration.md for every option.
# Where a document is cut: auto (its separators when it has one, its headings otherwise), separators, headings or both.
# The deepest heading that starts a slide.
# The shape of a slide when the source does not say it: '16:9' or '4:3'.
# The role the presenter routes ask for, when config/routes/phil_slides.yaml imports them; everyone else gets 403.
# The presenter view of a deck and the PDF of the deck with its notes, for the role phil_slides.presenter_role only.
# Uncomment to serve them, behind the firewall, once a service implements Phil\Slides\Application\Contract\PresentedDecks
# (see vendor/phil/slides/doc/presenter.md). The audience page stays a route of the application's own.
